name: interlogue
description: Brief it like a reporter. It interviews the subject and returns a case study with every quote cited to a transcript timestamp. Text-only path in this bundle; the phone path needs credentials that are not included.
long_description: InterLogue is an MCP server. Brief it (brief), record a human approval of the exact person and number (approve_contact), run the interview on the built-in fictional fixture (run_interview), get the reporter's packet (draft_piece), write the piece in Claude, and check_citations publishes it only if every quoted span is verbatim from the subject at the cited timestamp. Story first, pull quotes with timestamps second, the verbatim per-question record third.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Persist the assignment brief and build the question plan.

tools.name: approve_contact
tools.description: Record a human's approval of one specific person and number.

tools.name: run_interview
tools.description: Text-only interview from a fixture or inline turns; refuses without approval and consent.

tools.name: draft_piece
tools.description: The reporter's packet for writing the piece, or INTERVIEW TOO THIN.

tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Fact-check a written piece; publishes only when every quote resolves.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Where a brief sits in the spine.
